description: Add and update learners in Litmos, assign courses and learning paths to people and teams, and follow sign-ins, assignments, completions and certificates.

litmos_course_assigned_trigger.description: Runs when a course is assigned to a person directly (not through a team).

output.assignment: The record returned by the service

litmos_course_completed_trigger.description: Runs when a person completes a course.

output.result: The record returned by the service

litmos_course_progress_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a person's progress on a course changes, such as starting it or finishing a module.

output.result: The record returned by the service

litmos_learning_path_assigned_trigger.description: Runs when a learning path is assigned to a person directly (not through a team).

output.assignment: The record returned by the service

litmos_learning_path_completed_trigger.description: Runs when a person completes a learning path.

output.result: The record returned by the service

litmos_module_completed_trigger.description: Runs when a person completes a module of a course, such as a video, quiz or assessment.

output.result: The record returned by the service

litmos_new_achievement_trigger.description: Runs when a person earns an achievement, such as completing a course or getting a certificate.

output.achievement: The record returned by the service

litmos_new_course_trigger.description: Runs when a course is created.

output.course: The record returned by the service

litmos_new_team_trigger.description: Runs when a team is created.

output.team: The record returned by the service

litmos_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when a person is added to Litmos.

output.user: The record returned by the service

litmos_user_added_to_team_trigger.description: Runs when a person joins a team.

output.membership: The record returned by the service

litmos_user_signed_in_trigger.description: Runs when a person signs in to Litmos.

output.user: The record returned by the service

litmos_user_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a person's details change in Litmos.

output.user: The record returned by the service
